from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialAssetMatch(BaseModel):
    """A potential match for 'Other Current Assets' found within a single financial filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company the report belongs to")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact text label used on the balance sheet line item")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the asset")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the amount (e.g., 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars')")
    financial_section: str | None = Field(description="The broader section label (e.g., 'Current Assets', 'Assets')")
    report_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the financial statement covers (e.g., 'March 31, 2024')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    other_current_assets: list[FinancialAssetMatch]
